name: ESN Guardian
tagline: Advanced Discord protection for communities that take security seriously.
description: Built-in Guardian security console with protection configuration, local security scans, case logging, and a connector-ready profile for live Discord enforcement.

name: ESN SMP
description: Built-in ESN SMP companion with server addresses, season tracking, command shortcuts, exclusive-set tracking, and an event journal.

name: ESN CAM
tagline: Live Minecraft camera and map technology.
description: Built-in ESN CAM Render Lab with procedural block scenes, camera controls, telemetry, and PNG capture. Live Minecraft feeds can be connected later.

name: ESN Website Builder
tagline: Turn an idea into a website in minutes.
description: Built-in mobile website creator with live previews, saved projects, theme controls, and complete HTML export.

name: ESN Status
tagline: Know when every ESN service is online.
description: Built-in HTTPS reachability monitor with custom services, device-side checks, and saved status entries.

name: ESN Nexus
tagline: Your command center for the ESN ecosystem.
description: Built-in ESN workspace with quick app launching, a project task board, and persistent notes.

name: ESN Arcade
tagline: Fast games, challenges, and competitive scores.
description: Built-in arcade with three playable games: Reaction Test, Click Rush, and Number Lock, including saved local highscores.

name: ESN Hosting Console
tagline: A premium interface for servers, bots, and deployments.
description: Built-in server fleet planner with instance profiles, RAM totals, startup-command generation, local states, and JSON export. Remote control requires a hosting API.
